statement.text: Conjecture The poset of multifuncoids of the form $(\mathscr{P}\mho)^n$ is for every sets $\mho$ and $n$: - atomic; - atomistic. See below for definition of all concepts and symbols used to in this conjecture. Refer to this Web site for the theory which I now attempt to generalize.

title: Atomicity of the poset of multifuncoids
